structure_and_depth.location: Complete assigned English outline: effective brief, reasoning units 1-6, output paragraph and five evidence questions
structure_and_depth.basis: The outline makes measurement consistency a prerequisite for growth analysis, then links demand/monetization to distribution control, cash and revenue allocation, operating rules and participant-specific decisions. This order answers the original causal question rather than becoming a company catalogue. It explicitly separates reach, time, frequency, payment conversion and ad yield, asks whether app growth is unique demand or migration, and recognizes overlap and retained-evidence limits. The planned platform comparison connects recommendation/search, acquisition, customer relationship, IP, exclusivity and settlement to economic differences while avoiding causal rankings from unmatched audiences. The value-flow and scenario sections distinguish user/advertiser cash, recognized revenue, gross/contribution/net profit and domestic/overseas consolidation; production, acquisition, refunds, sharing, viewing and retention enter as mechanisms and sensitivity inputs. Regulation is positioned as an operating and financing variable, and the synthesis requires contrary evidence and reversal conditions. Representative company names are qualified by evidence availability rather than a mandatory fixed roster. The planned substantive units, integrated matrices and value-flow analysis can support the complete English report; the outline does not claim already established growth or profitability conclusions. No necessary structure/depth correction is found at this outline stage. This assessment is limited to the plan, not approval of the unwritten full report or verification of the 39 listed originals.
